answer: Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay stops fakes: each newcomer needs a sponsor who locks 200 credits and is slashed jointly if proved fake. The stake thaws like a glacier, freeing 20 credits per epoch after five clean epochs, so it cannot be reused at once. A proved fake leaves a pigment mark on the sponsor's record; three marks halve future sponsorship rights. Each sponsor holds five jade tokens, one per newcomer, so the 1,000th fake still costs 200 credits and 1,000 fakes need 200 sponsors and 200,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 200 once; idle reputation decays 5% per epoch.
